searchText: <@340345049063882753>, I'd like to consult with someone from Optimism. I want to propose simplification of [EIP-7708: ETH transfers and burns emit a log](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7708) by completely removing the "burn" feature from SELFDESTRUCT (in Cancun we removed the "burn" feature partly). The draft of the proposal is described in [Replace Burn Events with Balance-Preserving SELFDESTRUCT Finalization](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7708-eth-transfers-emit-a-log/20034/63). This very much make sense for Ethereum Mainnet because since the latest change to SELFDESTRUCT in Cancun such events happened only twice, likely by accident: [full report](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7708-eth-transfers-emit-a-log/20034/65). However, I know Optimism-like L2s are using the burn feature directly in the ETH L2→L1 bridging. What do you think? cc <@547171287831805972> <@1341963684477407333> Yeah we do curently burn funds as part of withdrawals, not sure exactly how important that is for us (definitely have to make the funds inaccessible, don't necessarily have to burn them I don't think). <@467031582146822144> is the best contact.

excerpts.content:
<@340345049063882753>, I'd like to consult with someone from Optimism. I want to propose simplification of [EIP-7708: ETH transfers and burns emit a log](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7708) by completely removing the "burn" feature from SELFDESTRUCT (in Cancun we removed the "burn" feature partly). The draft of the proposal is described  in [Replace Burn Events with Balance-Preserving SELFDESTRUCT Finalization](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7708-eth-transfers-emit-a-log/20034/63). This very much make sense for Ethereum Mainnet because since the latest change to SELFDESTRUCT in Cancun such events happened only twice, likely by accident: [full report](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-7708-eth-transfers-emit-a-log/20034/65).

However, I know Optimism-like L2s are using the burn feature directly in the ETH L2→L1 bridging. What do you think? 

cc <@547171287831805972> <@1341963684477407333>

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: Yeah we do curently burn funds as part of withdrawals, not sure exactly how important that is for us (definitely have to make the funds inaccessible, don't necessarily have to burn them I don't think).   <@467031582146822144>  is the best contact.
